note: The findings list Patient mapping requirements (birthDate, gender, identifier.value, etc.) that require rules in groups for Patient/Observation resources. The authorized insertion points only allow appending top-level QuestionnaireMap rules for QuestionnaireResponse.item elements. No valid pointer exists to create the required Patient/Observation mapping rules in this patch scope. Additionally, the 147 existing rule pointers show no insertion point within Patient/Observation groups. Attempting these edits would require editing rules that do not exist yet or using unauthorized array indices.
